For rank z(d), Fibonacci matrix U^{z(d)}=F_{z(d)+1}I, with unit scalar; zero indices occur exactly at multiples of z(d). On each primitive gcd stratum, all and only U^{-j}(0,c), j=0,...,z(d)-1, c a unit, reach a first zero at j, disjoint by rank minimality. Multiplying back by m/d gives exactly φ(d) first hits at each time j; summing all d|m proves the boxed histogram and waiting-time moments including m=1,t=0,zero pair. The z(d)|z(m) extreme time is justified. Independent from-scratch finite enumeration compared every initial pair for m=1..44 (29,370 pairs, 1,553 stratum-time cells); corroborates, not proves, all-moduli identity.
